task.missing_information: What rsi is - the object has no name, no declared type, no census and no route. Whether the three 0x20 pairs are an array of three or three named members needs the reader that a census would provide.

The widget instances also add to the population the sized-by-argument ctype rule now governs - and unlike the instances found by the store-wide sweep, these two have their EXTENT readable at the construction site.
